laserFit.extent: Frustum-covered positive rays with real floor depth tests.
laserFit.width: Perspective-correct measured widths reduced to cubic contraction curves.

effectOcclusionFit.method: Foreground constraints resolve the scale/distance ambiguity of independently registered effect sprites. Sparse cubic world motion; calibrated camera, rigid hull and the near impact remain fixed.

bossArrival.camera: Perspective camera, aligned capital ship, open cylindrical background.

cylinder.lighting: Shared albedo; fitted ambient plus Lambert diffuse on cylinder facets.
cylinder.limitations: The observed rays constrain a near-axial circular cylinder. Fine tessellation and camera scale are not uniquely determined by the compressed footage.

hull.method: Inverse native pixel pitch fitted to a four-key perspective recession. Black-level reveal ends with the radial zoom exposure.

beams.method: Seven measured parallel rays with independent monochrome ring masks and color/width/opacity envelopes.

screenBlur.method: Fit a blurred five-pixel star footprint across several unobstructed stars per frame.

ship.method: Two weighted Bezier motion sections, a stationary plateau, and tangent continuation after leaving the reference viewport.

rockets.simulation: One nozzle emitter with measured sparse births and analytic velocity relaxation; two camera-continued size bands follow offscreen.
rockets.limitations: Occluded launch instants are inferred. The later offscreen streams retain measured statistical distributions rather than matching individual births.

foregroundFocusBlur.method: Gaussian edge-spread fit on straight body edges across eleven large rocket observations. Only the foreground band is softened; the shared atlas stays sharp.

launch.method: Joint fit of body-centre observations, including reverse motion near the nozzle. p(t)=p0+vTarget*t+(vInitial-vTarget)*(1-exp(-rate*t))/rate. One birth and velocity pair per tracked rocket; no per-frame position keys.

camera.firstPoseMethod: Extrapolated from exposed hull observations from 2768 onward; the faint 2761 pose is not used as an independent anchor.
camera.centerConstraint: The unshaken hull pivot projects exactly to the viewport center at 2859.
camera.shake: Seeded continuous local rotation noise after the authored path; zero at the 2859 alignment anchor and active through the 3034 whiteout.
camera.blur: Five exposure samples at the hull distance drive a shared separable screen Gaussian; it approximates depth-dependent camera blur.

impacts.method: One static 3D plane per burst. Fitted native intersection row and world hull contact over several phases, with a shared pixel-pitch prior. The hull alpha only gates the physical ray/plane depth test.

depthOfField.focus: Far hull during orbit; hull plane once frontal.

hullFlash.method: Ranged material whiteMix overrides on the original hull; the continuous whitening ramp resumes between flashes.

smoke.simulation: Two seeded local-space emitters with a grayscale palette. Individual emission locations remain statistical.
smoke.limitations: A few bottom-edge cells are outside the source viewport; only these cells use the outer/inner silhouette fit. Resolution is the compact fitted grid, not independently known source-file metadata.

transitionBeam.method: A two-key weighted Bezier fitted to 53 measured stripe widths. World-plane line coverage extends across the finite frustum; only additional aspect span expands during the final six frames.
transitionBeam.limitations: At 3034 both stripe edges are offscreen. The final width is inferred from the fitted curve; the recording only supplies a lower bound. Camera shake matches the measured amplitude, not individual frame offsets.

shockRings.method: Six monotone radius tracks, each with two keys; X/Y diameter bindings share each track. Planes remain in world space. Hollow ellipses use SVG curves in DOM and analytic fragment coverage in Babylon.
shockRings.limitations: Subframe births, exits and weighted handles are selected interpolants. The 2985/2986 singleton pulses share the measured 2981/2982 expansion speed by choice. Camera shake is procedural; individual measured center offsets are not keyed. The initial occluded pixel-atlas core is omitted.

returnFlight.limitations: The original star and exhaust populations are reproduced as seeded distributions; individual particles are not tracked. Unexposed palette phases retain the earlier measured cycle. The concentric sprite uses binary alpha with a 5/6 cell fill ratio estimated through the compressed glow.

transition.equation: max(abs((p - cellCenter) / halfCellSize)) <= progress(t) - inset + curvature(t) * squaredDistance(p, center)

curves.method: Three weighted Bezier keys per scalar. The first segment is an exact subdivision of the five-frame contour fit; the final segment uses measured subpixel dot coverage, with a nonnegative monotone progress curve and zero terminal curvature.

transition.notes: Three weighted Bezier keys per scalar curve. Spatial deformation is evaluated at each boundary point, not at the tile center. The source editor and original parameter names are unknown.

flashback.motion: Piecewise linear paths with retained holds, measured from native pixel grids. Pose changes are independent stepped tracks.

viewportRetreat.aspect: Uniform fraction of the current fitted viewport; scene projection and controls remain independent.
